main.description: A talk, poster, panel, or tutorial. Posters and talks share one record type with a `type` enum rather than getting separate lexicons: their fields are identical and splitting them would produce two near-duplicate schemas that every consumer must implement twice.

eventName.description: Conference, workshop, or seminar series as it should be printed.

eventSeries.description: Stable series name across years, e.g. 'NeurIPS', '日本物理学会年次大会'. Lets an AppView group editions.

host.description: Hosting or inviting institution. For an invited seminar this is the CV-relevant part, not the event name.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Absent for online-only events.

language.description: BCP-47. Japanese CVs routinely separate 国内学会(和文) from international talks.

refereed.description: Whether the abstract was peer reviewed. Distinguishes a screened conference talk from an open call.

presenterRole.description: 'coAuthorNotPresenting' is listed on many CVs but must be distinguishable, since claiming a talk you did not give is a real integrity issue.

relatedWork.description: StrongRef to the pub.paper.reference this talk presented, when one exists.
